{{Current events|year=2022|month=11|day=9|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[2022 Ukrainian southern counteroffensive]]
****[[Russian Ground Forces|Russian forces]] announce a [[Withdrawal (military)|retreat]] from the city of [[Kherson]], the western bank of the [[Dnieper|Dnieper River]] in [[Russian occupation of Mykolaiv Oblast|Mykolaiv Oblast]], and the western part of [[Russian occupation of Kherson Oblast|Kherson Oblast]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-63573387 (BBC News)]
****Russian officials say that deputy head of the [[Kherson military–civilian administration]] [[Kirill Stremousov]] has been killed in a car crash while travelling to [[Crimea]]. Russian President [[Vladimir Putin]] issues a decree posthumously awarding Stremousov the [[Order of Courage (Russia)|Order of Courage]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-63572668 (BBC News)]
*[[Islamist insurgency in the Sahel]]
**[[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] announces the official end of [[Operation Barkhane]] in the [[Sahel]]. [https://www.africanews.com/2022/11/09/france-officially-ends-anti-jihadist-barkhane-operation-ponders-new-strategy/ (Africanews)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**A [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] teenager is killed and three others are injured in [[Nablus]] as clashes occur between [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] and the [[Al-Aqsa Martyrs' Brigade]] at [[Joseph's Tomb]] when the latter allegedly opened fire on [[Jewish]] worshippers. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/palestinian-teen-killed-as-gunmen-attack-pilgrimage-of-mks-to-nablus-josephs-tomb/ (''Times of Israel'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**[[Economy of Greece]]
***[[Greeks|Greek]] workers begin a strike demanding higher wages amid rapidly increasing inflation in the country, with the main [[trade union]] calling it "suffocating". Ground transport, flights, and ferry services are disrupted due to the strike. [https://www.reuters.com/article/greece-inflation-strike/greek-workers-walk-out-over-suffocating-inflation-idINL8N32480M (Reuters)]
**[[2021–present United Kingdom cost of living crisis]]
***The [[United Kingdom|UK]]'s [[Royal College of Nursing]] announces the first [[Industrial action|strike]] in the union's 106-year history as it demands higher wages for medical workers in order to keep up with rising [[inflation]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-63561317 (BBC News)]
**The [[International Monetary Fund]] agrees to a preliminary deal with [[Bangladesh]] for a US[[$]]4.5 billion loan to support the struggling [[Economy of Bangladesh|Bangladeshi economy]] amid rising energy and food prices. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/11/9/140 (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Nicole (2022)|Tropical Storm Nicole]] makes landfall in the [[Bahamas]], with [[flooding]] and [[power outage]]s reported in the [[Abaco Islands]]. In the [[United States]], [[Walt Disney World]] and other resorts in [[Florida]] close because of the storm. [https://apnews.com/article/hurricanes-miami-florida-storms-weather-3132c7afa0d80797296f7bc6cd9d3a97 (AP)]
*Nine people are killed in a house fire in [[Yıldırım, Bursa| Yıldırım]], [[Bursa Province]], [[Turkey]]. [https://apnews.com/article/europe-middle-east-fires-turkey-migration-0149e674198ae282ce2a23f1c28213d1 (AP)]
